DONE — landed as Gerrit change 1898 (merged to main as d361eb28e4).

Acceptance criteria — all met:
1. [x] No ambient config/credential read below the seam: 41 cut-to-seam + 6 owned-in-place markers (marker-total==6); check_config_ownership.py exit 0.
2. [x] 45 LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS rows removed; AST gate passes with no path-glob exception.
3. [x] Root + typed Config composed ONCE at pass entry, threaded via _PassContext; 3 identity reads keep distinct per-call-site semantics; bridge_fsck L692 + _engine_support resolve from composition root, signatures unchanged.
4. [x] Regression green: Verified+1 on CI (full suite passed ubuntu py3.11/3.12/3.13 + macos py3.13) + LLM-Review+1.

Held-out TDD: oracle tests/scripts/test_reconciler_core_seam_clean_heldout.py (10 tests) authored RED-first, held out from implementer; validated GREEN with teeth (behavioral + structural mutations confirmed RED then restored).

Regression fix during review: LLM-Review flagged reconciler modules that had swapped the deterministic CWD-INDEPENDENT parents[4] fallback for config.repo_root() (git-toplevel-of-cwd, wrong for a daemon). Added owned config.reconciler_repo_root() (REBAR_ROOT or package root, no subprocess), pointed all 13 reconciler sites at it; RED-first tests added to oracle.
